title: Scheme open restriction inverts the unit of its derived right adjunction
statement: Fix derived categories of modules for every scheme [def-pc-derived-category], a scheme X and an open U⊆X [def-pc-scheme]. Let r_U:D(O_X)→D(O_U) be the derived exact-open restriction [def-pc-derived-open-restriction-maps], Rj_U*:D(O_U)→D(O_X) the derived direct image [def-pc-derived-direct-image], and a any supplied adjunction r_U⊣Rj_U*. For every K∈D(O_X), r_U(a.unit_K) is an isomorphism. No derived-category instance on the intermediate over-site module category is required.

source.place: Tags 08BS and 08FE, exact open restriction and extension by zero; the adjunction triple argument

proof.text: Let E be the equivalence from modules on the over-site of U to modules on U. Transport the exact extension-by-zero adjunction G₀⊣F₀ along E, obtaining G=E inverse;G₀ left adjoint to F=schemeOpenRestriction X U. Exactness passes through the equivalence.

The extension/restriction isomorphism G₀;F₀≅id, whiskered by E inverse and E and followed by E counit, gives G;F≅id. Derive the exact functors and localize the termwise adjunction, giving G_D⊣F_D. Derived composition, the derived image of the composite isomorphism and the derived identity comparison give G_D;F_D≅id.

Adjunction.fullyFaithfulLOfCompIsoId makes G_D fully faithful. Apply Adjunction.Triple.fullyFaithfulEquiv to G_D⊣F_D⊣Rj_U* to make the right adjoint fully faithful. Its counit is invertible; the left triangle identity makes F_D of its unit invertible. This argument works for any supplied right adjunction and includes empty opens.

proof_origin.place: Transport to scheme modules before deriving; adjunction-triple proof of restricted-unit invertibility

mathlib_searches.query: In an adjoint triple, full faithfulness of the left adjoint implies full faithfulness of the right adjoint and the unit becomes invertible after applying the middle functor
mathlib_searches.results: Adjunction.Triple.fullyFaithfulEquiv, Adjunction.fullyFaithfulLOfCompIsoId, and instIsIsoMapAppUnitOfFaithfulOfFull provide the abstract part. No theorem for the scheme exact-open functor with only scheme-derived-category instances.
Mathlib.CategoryTheory.Adjunction.Triple, equivalence between full faithfulness of the two outer adjoints; used after constructing the scheme-derived adjoint triple.

Mathlib.CategoryTheory.Monad.Adjunction defines fullyFaithfulLOfCompIsoId. Project supplies exact extension adjunction and extension/restriction isomorphism; no scheme-derived restricted-unit theorem.

mathlib_searches.query: Derived exact open restriction inverts the adjunction unit and canonical derived base change is natural in coefficient objects

lean.statement:
theorem schemeDerivedOpen_unit_isIso (X : Scheme.{u}) (U : X.Opens)
    (adj : (schemeOpenRestriction X U).mapDerivedCategory ⊣ schemeDerivedDirectImage U.ι)
    (K : schemeDerivedCategory X) :
    IsIso ((schemeOpenRestriction X U).mapDerivedCategory.map (adj.unit.app K))
